drhp.business: The Company is engaged in the manufacture of Performance Polymers & Chemicals and Agri Products comprising Single Super Phosphate and a wide range of Crop Nutrition and Crop Growth products, from plants at Gajraula and Sahibabad in Uttar Pradesh, Kapasan in Rajasthan and Savli in Gujarat. It is the sole manufacturer of food grade Polyvinyl Acetate (PVAc) in India (Gajraula) and the dominant player in VP Latex (Savli), and sells branded wood adhesives, wood finishes and agri products under well-known brands. risks.note: The Risk Management Committee's mandate requires a framework for identification of internal and external risks specifically faced by the listed entity, in particular financial and operational risks, together with mitigation measures, internal control systems and a business continuity plan.
risks.risk: Financial and operational risk across the business

risks.note: Sectoral risk is named explicitly in the Risk Management Committee's risk-identification framework, and the Committee is required to review the risk management policy at least once in two years considering changing industry dynamics and evolving complexity.
The Committee's framework specifically calls out sustainability risks, particularly ESG related risks, as a category to be identified, mitigated and monitored.
Information and cyber security risks are named in the Risk Management Committee's terms of reference as risks requiring an identification framework, mitigation measures and internal controls.

The Board has delegated to the Finance Committee powers to borrow up to an aggregate ` 1,250 Crores outstanding at any point of time (of which term loans not exceeding ` 500 Crores), to raise up to ` 60 Crores via commercial paper or other money market instruments, and to create mortgages/charges on movable and immovable properties up to ` 1,250 Crores to secure those borrowings.
risks.risk: Leverage and financing risk from delegated borrowing powers

risks.note: The Finance Committee is empowered to deal with purchase or sale of spot and forward foreign exchange against exports, imports and foreign currency loans of the Company and other forex transactions including derivatives, indicating structural currency exposure.
risks.risk: Foreign exchange exposure on exports, imports and foreign currency loans

risks.note: Delegated powers include giving inter-corporate loans up to ` 5 Crores to subsidiaries, guarantees or security up to ` 20 Crores in connection with structured trade finance such as channel finance, availing factoring/payable financing/bill discounting facilities, and investments in bodies corporate up to ` 50 Crores.
risks.risk: Contingent exposure from guarantees, inter-corporate loans and structured trade finance
